title: feat(plugin-list, plugin-chatbot): the list view and the chatbot pick with the shared Select (objectui#11865, slice p)
body:
Part of #11865
Clause-②: no

Slice p of claim `6073419396` (`domain:ui` seat 2, account `os-bill`, session `session_01MgfduSkFrfM3eorB3UGfAU`): the native selects left in the list view and the chatbot now use the shared Radix `Select` from `@object-ui/components`, the control the rest of the console picks with. It follows the card's landed slices (objectui#11976 through objectui#12021): items carry option indexes, so an option whose value is `''` needs no empty `SelectItem`, and a stored value outside the options shows as its own item. Each picker is module-private; nothing new is exported.

| File | Control | Picker | Console chunk (base build) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` | "Color by field", in the toolbar's Color popover | `ListOptionPicker` | `plugins-views`, eager |
| `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` | "Rows per page", in the record-count bar of views without a grid pager | `ListOptionPicker` | `plugins-views`, eager |
| `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` | the composer's model picker | `ModelPicker` | `plugin-chatbot`, eager |

**Count first.** On base `2063f7a96` the census matched 3 lines in `ListView.tsx` and 1 in `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`; the real elements are 2 and 1. The third `ListView.tsx` line sat in the multi-line JSX comment above the rows-per-page selector ("Rendering a second native select here produced a duplicate control"). That comment now says "a second selector", so the census stops counting it. On head, each file matches the census once more, in prose: the new picker's docblock says the control "used to be a browser-native select", in the same words as the twin's docblock.

## What stays the same

Every option writes what the native control wrote. A scratch probe on base `2063f7a96` fired a `change` event for every option of each native control and recorded the write. Each pin compares against those readings as JSON text:
- **Color by field:** the row-colour config the list hands its grid, over four configs: none, a field with colours, a field with no colours, and a field none of the options carries. "None" still writes `undefined`, and a picked field keeps the config's colours.
- **Rows per page:** the size handed to `onPageSizeChange`, and the next fetch's `$top`, over three paginations: a declared 25, none declared, and a declared 7.
- **Model picker:** the id handed to `onModelChange`, over three selections: none (the first model is in force), an offered model, and a model none of the options carries.

Re-picking the current option writes nothing, as a browser's native select did. The probe's synthetic `change` fired for the current option too, so the re-pick rows pin the primitive.

**Accessible names:**
- The model picker keeps its name, the `aria-label` its `model` label gives it (pinned, with a label override).
- "Color by field" and "Rows per page" had no name on base: the colour label has no `htmlFor`, the "Rows per page" text is a span, neither had an `aria-label`, and the probe read an empty name. So none is kept, and none is added, as slice m did for the twin.

**Keys:** Enter opens each picker and Enter on an option selects it; pinned on all three. In the chatbot this happens inside the composer's form, and the draft is not sent (pinned).

**Read-only:** the list's two surfaces have no read-only state. The chatbot's `readOnly` transcript has no composer, so no picker, as before (pinned). Its `disabled` prop did not disable the native select on base and does not disable the picker now: unchanged, and noted below.

## One display change

A value none of a picker's options carries now shows as itself. On base, the native select showed its first option instead:
- a row-colour field `ghost` outside the list's columns read "None", while the popover's Clear button said a rule was set;
- a page size in force that is not an option read as the first option: with none declared (an unpaged view fetches 100) and with a declared 7, the selector read "10". In a browser that first option could then not be picked, since the native select already showed it as selected;
- a selected model the environment no longer offers read as the first model.

All three are pinned, and picking the outside item writes nothing.

"Color by field" now matches its twin, `ViewSettingsPopover`'s `ColorFieldPicker` (objectui#12019), whose header asks the two to stay in step: the same outside item and the same "None" handling. `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` is not edited.

## objectui#11984's field-read pin, carried in

`ListView.fieldListRead-11984.test.tsx` read `ListView`'s own "Color by field" through native-select readers. They now read the shared `Select`:
- the wide toolbar's Row color position reads the listbox through the pin's `pickerLabels()`; the native `selectLabels()` helper is removed;
- the stored-config row-colour row reads the trigger text and the listbox, where it read `toHaveValue`;
- one row is added: a rule on an unreadable field that is also outside the columns gets no outside item. The picker is handed the offered rule (`offeredRowColorConfig`), so a field the caller may not read never reaches that item.

Every enumerated position still asserts the same field set. The ablations ran through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. Each printed "ok mutation landed", then "ok restored: blob == HEAD" with `git diff HEAD` empty.

| Ablation of `ListView.tsx` | Pin on base `2063f7a96` | Pin on head `16f8fa0c5` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `allFields` drops `canReadField` (object columns) | 11 of 20 red | 13 of 21 red |
| `offeredRowColorConfig` drops `canReadField` | not run | 2 of 21 red (head `6c4bf4ff1`) |

- **`allFields` ablation:** the base 11 stay red, the wide Row color position and the View settings one among them. Both stored-config row-colour rows join them, red at the listbox read, which offered "Secret Note" and "Secret Status". On base the stored-config row stayed green: its native reader never read `allFields`. Their full-read legs cannot turn red under this ablation, by construction: with full read, `canReadField` answers true.
- **`offeredRowColorConfig` ablation:** both stored-config row-colour rows turn red, and the trigger reads `secret_note`. That is the outside item naming a withheld field, the exact hazard the added row pins.
- Neither the pin nor `ListView.tsx` changed after the heads named.

**Reverse leg** (both sources put on their base blobs and checked by hash, trap-restored to HEAD, blob checked): the five touched test files read "Tests 54 failed | 255 passed (309)".
- `ListView.sharedSelect-11865`: 34 of 34 red.
- `ChatbotEnhanced.modelPicker-11865`: 13 red, 2 green. The green rows are the name row and the read-only row, which keep a behaviour.
- `ListView.test`: 3 red (the page-size readers), 145 green.
- `ListView.fieldListRead-11984`: 3 red (the Row color position and both stored-config row-colour rows), 18 green.
- `ChatbotEnhanced.test`: 1 red (the model-picker test), 90 green.

| base `2063f7a96` | 3,237,430 | 10,893,710 | 289 of 2474 |
| head `4a02099e4` | 3,237,589 | 10,894,267 | 289 of 2474 |
| delta | **+159** | +557 | 0 |

- The movers are `plugin-chatbot` (+153 gzip / +335 raw: `ModelPicker`) and `plugins-views` (+18 / +222: `ListOptionPicker`; the twin already brings the shared `Select` into that chunk). The rest is minifier churn: `index` -8, `studioScope` -2, `ViewVariantInspector` -1, `src` -1.
- `pnpm check:eager-closure` on the head build prints "Console eager closure is 3161.7 KB gzipped across 289 of 2474 chunks (budget: 3204.6 KB, headroom: 42.8 KB)", with the chunk membership green.
- `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` is untouched.

## Evidence (head `4a02099e4`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-list/ packages/plugin-chatbot/ packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/column-identity.ratchet.test.ts scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`, at the repo root under the lock, reads "Test Files 185 passed (185)" and "Tests 1992 passed (1992)", with VERDICT command-exit 0.
- After building the closure (`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-list^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-chatbot^...' run build`: 13 of 47 projects, exit 0):
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list type-check` exits 0;
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot type-check` exits 0;
  - each runs `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, and `--listFilesOnly` lists all five touched test files.
- `pnpm exec eslint --format json` on the 7 touched source and test files reads 0 errors. Warnings per file equal the base blob's: `ListView.tsx` 187, `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` 10, `ListView.test.tsx` 26. The others, both new pins included, read 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exits 0: "7 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` exits 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` exits 0: "0 new citation(s)".
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` exits 0, and a control-byte grep over the changed files finds nothing.

## Not on it

- No write path beyond the control swap.
- Not touched: `packages/components/src/ui/**`, `packages/i18n/**`, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (slice o), `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` and `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`.
- No README or guide describes these three controls' markup, so no doc changes. The one native select in the chatbot README is consumer example code for `useAgents`.

## Acceptance notes

- "Color by field" and "Rows per page" have no accessible name, on base and on head. Their visible labels are not associated with them. Slice m noted the same for the twin. Carrier: none.
- In `AiChatPage.tsx`, the comment beside `models=` says the chatbot "renders the footer" native select. It is now the shared `Select`. That is wording only, in a file outside this slice. Carrier: the next PR that touches `AiChatPage.tsx`.
- The chatbot's `disabled` prop disables the composer's textarea and submit, but not the model picker, on base and on head. This slice keeps that. Carrier: none.
- `elements/prompt-input.tsx` already exports `PromptInputSelect` wrappers around the shared `Select`, and nothing calls them. This slice uses the shared `Select` directly, as triage directs. Carrier: none.
